data.name: Crowns & Chaos
data.detailed_description:
The Romans have finally gone too far.

Not content with invading Gaul the old-fashioned way, the Romans have turned to forbidden black magic, summoning hordes of supernatural horrors to crush the resistance once and for all.

Standing between these monsters and your village is one very determined druid.

Fight wave after wave of cursed creatures, collect powerful weapons and magical gear, manage your inventory, and discover new ways to survive. The run grows more dangerous as increasingly deadly enemies emerge.

How long can you hold the line before the village falls?

Features

  • Fast-paced 2D wave survival combat

  • Unlock and equip powerful weapons and gear

  • Inventory and equipment management

  • Endless enemy waves that grow harder over time

  • Build your druid your way and chase new survival records

  • Romans, monsters, and a healthy amount of questionable magic

Survive. Adapt. Defend.

data.short_description: Crowns & Chaos is a 2D, pixel art, arena shooter roguelike. Become a Gaulish druid and combine the power of up to 5 weapons to fend off hordes of supernatural enemies summoned by the Romans and survive as many waves as possible. Between waves buy new weapons, gears, and upgrade your stats.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated graphics with DirectX 11 / OpenGL 3.3 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Designed for keyboard and mouse.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible or OpenGL 3.3-compatible graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system. Designed for keyboard and mouse.
